_comment: Copy this file to settings.json and fill in the blanks. settings.json is git-ignored.
_lease_scan_comment: Photo scan on New lease. Put your Claude API key in anthropic_api_key in config/settings.json (git-ignored), or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Pages are sent to the Claude API and kept in data/scans/.

kijiji._comment: Whole locations, newest first, read until caught up with what the desk has seen (max_pages_per_search caps it). No sort/address/ll/radius parameters: Kijiji's robots.txt asks robots not to use them, and the area check sorts ads into areas anyway.

_sources_comment: Routes the desk uses. 'alerts' reads Stefan's own saved-search emails and is always on. The six scanners (kijiji, craigslist, logisquebec, livrent, appartogo, lespac) are listed here but read nothing until that board's entry under 'permissions' is turned on. Facebook, Rentals.ca, PadMapper/Zumper and Louer.ca have no scanner: email alerts where the board offers them, the capture button otherwise. See SCANNER-LAUNCH.md.
_permissions_comment: One entry per scanner. A board is read only when scan_enabled is true AND letter names the board's written permission (file path or email subject and date) AND expires (YYYY-MM-DD, optional) has not passed. Copy the limits the letter sets: max_requests_per_hour caps requests per board per hour, min_interval_seconds spaces requests to its site. Nesi turns scan_enabled on, in config/settings.json, once the letter is in. Never on before that.

scan._comment: A board is read again only when its last good read is older than its freshness window (minutes). Requests to one host are at least min_interval_seconds apart (more if robots.txt sets a Crawl-delay), plus up to jitter x that at random.

alerts._comment: Saved-search alert emails from the boards. Either drop .eml files in data/inbox/, or fill in imap to read one mailbox folder read-only (password in the macOS keychain under keychain_service). See README, Email alerts.
